h: The Red Heifer and Shabbos Restore the Divine Presence

p: In the Ra'aya Mehemna on this parsha
from the side of Gevurah, etc."
(Midrash Rabbah and Tanchuma on this parsha):
"A parable of the son of a maidservant, etc.;
and atone for the deed of the Calf."
the resting of the Shechinah was nullified,
and through the act of the heifer
the resting of the Shechinah returns.
And this is what it says:

is through the attribute of yirah,

and this is in the manner of
"Fortunate are those whose way is complete,
who walk in the Torah of Hashem."
And this is what it says:
for through the mitzvah of milah
he merited the words of Torah
from the side of the middle pillar;
and this is the holiness of Yaakov Avinu,
who merited that his bed was complete,
that each one of his seed
of having a share in the World to Come,
from the side of the upper Shechinah.
they will merit to rectify at the root,
which is the aspect of Binah,
"And his heart will understand, and he will return,"
so that the yetzer hara will not be able
And this is what it says
'and for the upright of heart, joy'" (Tehillim 97:11);
for the Other Side to rule";
that it uses the phrase of the pasuk,
that the main purpose of the heifer
is to purify from the impurity of the dead,
And at the beginning it opened:
"It is forbidden to plow on Shabbos
with the plowing of an ox,
and it has no connection here.
for it is stated in the holy Zohar
the secret of the three Avos,
and the 'daughter' is crowned with them."
corresponding to the holiness of Avraham Avinu,
corresponding to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu,
it is forbidden to plow the earth
and to make pits in it,
And this is what it says:
"It is forbidden to plow on Shabbos
with the plowing of an ox"
which is the kelipah of Esav,
which is the opposite of the attribute of yirah,
being the Gevurah of the kelipah.
the kelipah of iniquity and destroyer,
"And He abundantly turns back His anger
and does not arouse all His wrath":
they will merit the days of Mashiach;
in the Zohar Chadash, Ki Savo:
is written with the Name Havayah,
which is the Name of mercy.
that He not arouse all His wrath,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there,
the whole corruption of the Nachash
which is the kelipah of the serpent,
And this is what it says:
And this is what it says:

paragraphs.text: Source: Bamidbar 19:2 — “זאת חקת התורה אשר צוה יהוה לאמר דבר  אל בני ישראל ויקחו אליך פרה אדמה תמימה אשר אין בה מום אשר לא עלה עליה על” — “This is the ritual law that יהוה has commanded: Instruct the Israelite people to bring you a red cow without blemish, in which there is no defect and on which no yoke has been laid.”
